description.narrative:
1. The ILO Global Business and Disability Network (GBDN)-China Chapter worked with the China Disabled Persons' Federation (CDPF) to advocate for a job coach system targeting persons with disabilities.
In July 2021, the central government issued the 14th national five year plan for 2021-2025. In September 2021, the government launched the national human rights work plan for 2021-2025. Both documents envisage the creation and promotion of a national job coach system for persons with disabilities.
2. The ILO Global Business and Disability Network China Chapter and local Disabled Persons Federations launched joint actions in ten cities to promote employment for graduates with disabilities in China in May 2021. Measures include creation of a database with information of People with Disabilities and companies providing posts for People with disabilities.
3. Peking University and Guangzhou Disabled Persons' Federation developed in November 2021 a training manual aiming to improve quality of training of local vocational training centre to enhance employability of people with disabilities.
4. HIV issue integrated into local poverty reduction program in Liangshan Prefecture in September 2021, with efforts of local Department of Labour and Women Network against AIDS-China. 1.The ILO Beijing Office and ILO GBDN-China provided the ILO Handbook on Supported Employment and technical inputs to CDPF when they drafted the plan of job coaching piloting in 2020; shared comments for formulation of the new five year plan. The ILO and GBDN-China also presented best practices on job coaching to officials of CDPF at the GBDN-China annual conference in Guangzhou city in Dec. 2020.
2. Supported the GBDN-China in working together with the local Disabled Persons Federations conducted campaigns. A series of meetings with participation of the local Disabled Persons Federation, the universities, and companies were organized from March to N. 2021 to facilitate the recruitment process.
3. The ILO and the Global Business and Disability Network-China, worked together with the Disabled Persons Federation in Guangzhou City to produce a Training Manual on Soft Skills for people with disabilities at Workplace. The training manual has been used by local vocational training centres to enhance confidence, willingness and abilities of people with disabilities in employment.
4. With the ILO support, MOHRSS carried out a study on HIV and Poverty in Sichuan Province and organized a workshop to discuss measures to be taken to address poverty among People Living with HIV, with participation of All China Federation of Trade Unions, China Enterprise Confederation, local department of labour and representatives of private sector. ILO has assisted Women Network against AIDS-China in organising two Start and Improve Your Business training workshops in Sichuan Province to improve capacity of People living with HIV on income generation, and reduce poverty among People living with HIV.

description.narrative:
A new Working Guide for the China New Enterprise-based Apprenticeship Program was developed by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security in August 2021, in which a chapter on Global Experience was created in line with ILO Toolkits for Quality Apprenticeship Volume 2: Guide for Practitioners and ILO Toolkit for Quality Apprenticeships Volume 1: Guide for Policymakers.
China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) developed a new Implementation Plan for its Apprenticeship Program in March 2021. The ILO, with funding from JP Morgan, introduced methodologies and tools on quality apprenticeship and core skills, which have been integrated into the China New Apprenticeship Program aiming at reducing job-skill mismatch, promote sustainable development of enterprises and enhance youth employability.
The ILO also translated and adapted four ILO Quality Apprenticeship tools and knowledge products into Chinese. The ILO introduced these tools and guides through both online and face-to-face capacity building workshops.
The ILO conducted local piloting and managed to involve a major large sector China National Petroleum Corporation and four municipalities. The ILO held seven capacity-build workshops in cooperation with Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China and invited international and national experts to share best practices in quality apprenticeship and vocational training. A total of 76 pilot organizations, including 39 enterprises (16 are SMEs), 32 Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) institutions and 5 local management departments participated in capacity building activities. Almost 1000 officials, enterprise managers and trainers, school teachers participated in capacity building workshops, ILO tool piloting and research.
